preconditions.expression: isinstance(t, int) and t >= 1 and t <= 50
preconditions.description: t is the number of test cases, an integer between 1 and 50 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(test_case, tuple) and len(test_case) == 3 for test_case in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case is a tuple of (N, P, M), where N is the number of computers, P is the number of connections, and M is the number of queries.

preconditions.expression: all(N >= 1 and N <= 1000 and P >= N - 1 and P <= 100000 and M >= 1 and M <= 100000 for N, P, M in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is between 1 and 1000, P is between N-1 and 100000, and M is between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(connections, list) and len(connections) == P and all(len(conn) == 3 for conn in connections) for _, _, _, connections in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case's connections are a list of P tuples, each tuple representing (u, v, d) where u and v are computer IDs and d is the distance.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N and 1 <= d <= 1000000 for N, _, _, connections in test_cases for u, v, d in connections)
preconditions.description: For each connection (u, v, d), u and v are computer IDs between 1 and N, and d is a distance between 1 and 1000000.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(queries, list) and len(queries) == M and all(len(query) == 2 for query in queries) for _, _, _, _, queries in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case's queries are a list of M tuples, each tuple representing (u, v) where u and v are computer IDs.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for N, _, _, _, queries in test_cases for u, v in queries)
preconditions.description: For each query (u, v), u and v are computer IDs between 1 and N.

preconditions.expression: all(u != v for N, _, _, connections in test_cases for u, v, _ in connections)
preconditions.description: No connection is from a computer to itself.

preconditions.expression: all(d1 != d2 for N, _, _, connections in test_cases for i in range(len(connections)) for j in range(i + 1, len(connections)) for d1, d2 in [(connections[i][2], connections[j][2])])
preconditions.description: All distances d in connections are unique within a test case.

postconditions.description: The output is a list of t results, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, list) and len(result) == M for result in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each test case result is a list of M answers, one for each query.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(answer, int) for result in return_value for answer in result)
postconditions.description: Each answer is an integer representing the minimum cable length.

postconditions.expression: all(answer >= 0 for result in return_value for answer in result)

all(any((u == q[0] and v == q[1]) or (u == q[1] and v == q[0]) for q in queries) for N, _, _, connections, queries, result in zip(test_cases, [connections for _, _, _, connections, _ in test_cases], [queries for _, _, _, _, queries in test_cases], return_value) for u, v in queries)
postconditions.description: Each query (u, v) must have a valid path in the constructed spanning tree.

postconditions.expression: all(answer == min(sum(d for u, v, d in path) for path in get_all_paths(u, v, connections)) for N, _, _, connections, queries, result in zip(test_cases, [connections for _, _, _, connections, _ in test_cases], [queries for _, _, _, _, queries in test_cases], return_value) for (u, v), answer in zip(queries, result))
postconditions.description: Each answer is the minimum total distance of a path between u and v in the constructed spanning tree.
